title: burn out
author: requiem
body:
welp, i'm 24 now, and this burn out is still here. i wonder if its a ptsd thing, or maybe im just constantly overstimulated :p
godddd its annoying. it feels like ive been dead for a few years now and im just dredging on and on, weed helps at least thank fuck. and at least im able to update my site sometimes :V. blehhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh*hhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh*.... i need to add ascii emojis to this post editor....
